# Parivartan (eParivartan)

> Parivartan (eParivartan) is a technology company based in Hyderabad, India, that designs and develops websites, mobile apps, custom applications and e-commerce platforms for businesses, institutions and government organisations, and provides SEO, AEO and GEO services.

Parivartan started in 2002 and has more than 24 years of experience in digital design and development. It delivers technology solutions across 20+ countries and works with international clients remotely. Designers and developers work together through each project, from requirements and UI/UX design to development, deployment and long-term support. Technology is chosen per project; capabilities include React, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Python, WordPress, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and REST APIs.

- Location: Flat no 201, Vasudha Avenue, Road Number 10, Kavuri Hills, Hyderabad - 500033, Telangana, India
- Phone: +91 98491 65443
- Email: feedback@eparivartan.com
- Working hours: Monday to Friday, 10:30 AM - 7:00 PM (IST)

## Core Services

- [Web Development](https://eparivartan.com/web-development.html): Corporate, institutional, government and content-rich websites, custom CMS, multilingual and accessible builds, with technical SEO foundations built in.
- [Mobile App Development](https://eparivartan.com/mobile-app-development.html): Mobile app design and development, from UI/UX through to launch and support.
- [Custom Applications](https://eparivartan.com/custom-applications.html): Custom software for complex business logic, workflows and operational systems, including portals and internal management tools.
- [UI/UX Design](https://eparivartan.com/ui-ux-design.html): Wireframes, visual design and interaction design that define layouts and functionality before development.
- [E-commerce Development](https://eparivartan.com/ecommerce-development.html): E-commerce websites and platforms with payment, CRM and third-party system integrations.
- [Search & AI Visibility (SEO / AEO / GEO)](https://eparivartan.com/seo-aeo-geo.html): Ongoing optimisation for search engines (SEO), answer engines (AEO) and generative AI platforms (GEO).
- [Technology Support](https://eparivartan.com/technology-support.html): Hosting support, SSL management, backups, security updates, monitoring, maintenance and enhancements.

## Case Studies

- [Rental App](https://eparivartan.com/rental-app-details.html): Mobile app for property rental management covering properties, tenants, locations, tenant onboarding and rent payment tracking.
- [Clap Kartel](https://eparivartan.com/clap-kartel-details.html): Social entertainment platform connecting artists, creators and film professionals through talent profiles, media sharing, rentals, jobs, learning and industry services.
- [CAD Career Coach](https://eparivartan.com/cad-career-coach-details.html): Career platform for civil and mechanical engineering students and professionals, with jobs, technical training, industry resources and recruiter connections.
- [Hemanth Enterprises](https://eparivartan.com/hemanth-enterprises-details.html): B2B sanitary solutions platform with multi-brand product selection, comparison, quotation generation and cost estimation.
- [HR Portal](https://eparivartan.com/hr-portal-details.html): Mobile workforce app for attendance, daily work reports, task tracking, leave balances and company announcements.
- [Minutes of Meeting](https://eparivartan.com/minutes-of-meeting-details.html): Meeting management platform that records, organises and summarises discussions, generates key points and action items, and shares them by email.
- [Tandoori Flames](https://eparivartan.com/tandoori-flames-details.html): Restaurant mobile app for food ordering, menu browsing, table reservation and real-time order tracking.
- [Vastra Sethu](https://eparivartan.com/vastra-sethu-details.html): Apparel and textile e-commerce platform connecting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers, with bulk ordering and real-time inventory tracking.
